name: Build Sandbox Images

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 */7 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*/build/**'
      - '*/manifest.json'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-images.yml'
      - 'wrangler.toml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*/build/**'
      - '*/manifest.json'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-images.yml'
      - 'wrangler.toml'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: sandbox-images-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || 'publish' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.templates.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Validate Catalog and Test Version Updates
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build.py --validate
          python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
          python3 scripts/readme.py
          python3 scripts/pack.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/catalog-check" --base-url https://sandbox-images.metorial.net --allow-unpublished
      - name: Discover Template Matrix
        id: templates
        run: echo "matrix=$(python3 scripts/build.py --matrix)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  build:
    needs: discover
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 120
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover.outputs.matrix) }}
    name: Build ${{ matrix.template }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Install Registry Copier
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends skopeo
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Build and Smoke Test Template
        env:
          TEMPLATE: ${{ matrix.template }}
          IMAGE_REGISTRY: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          PUBLISH: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) }}
        run: |
          publish_args=()
          if [ "$PUBLISH" = true ]; then
            publish_args+=(--publish)
          fi
          python3 scripts/build.py --template "$TEMPLATE" --prune-build-cache --registry "${IMAGE_REGISTRY,,}" "${publish_args[@]}"
      - name: Prepare Manifest Result
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
        env:
          TEMPLATE: ${{ matrix.template }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-results/$TEMPLATE"
          cp "$TEMPLATE/manifest.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-results/$TEMPLATE/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
        with:
          name: manifest-${{ matrix.template }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/manifest-results/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  deploy:
    needs: [discover, build]
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check Admin Merge Credential
        env:
          ADMIN_MERGE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SANDBOX_IMAGES_MERGE_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$ADMIN_MERGE_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo 'SANDBOX_IMAGES_MERGE_TOKEN must belong to an actor allowed to bypass the main branch ruleset.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: manifest-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/manifest-results
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Merge and Validate Matrix Manifests
        env:
          IMAGE_REGISTRY: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build.py --merge-manifests "$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-results" --registry "${IMAGE_REGISTRY,,}"
          python3 scripts/build.py --validate
          python3 scripts/readme.py
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - name: Pack Catalog and Retain Previous Releases
        run: python3 scripts/pack.py --base-url https://sandbox-images.metorial.net --retain-releases
      - name: Deploy Genesis Catalog to Cloudflare Pages
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: npx --yes wrangler@4.149.0 pages deploy dist --project-name sandbox-images --branch main
      - name: Create and Admin Merge Manifest Update
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ADMIN_MERGE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SANDBOX_IMAGES_MERGE_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          git add -- '*/manifest.json' README.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'All images and the template list are unchanged.'
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          update_branch="automation/sandbox-image-versions-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          git switch -c "$update_branch"
          git commit -m 'chore: update sandbox image versions [skip ci]'
          update_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$update_branch"
          body_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/manifest-update-pr.md"
          cat > "$body_file" <<'BODY'
          Updates the digest-pinned manifests after all template builds and smoke tests passed and the catalog was deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

          This automated release uses the configured administrator ruleset bypass. The merge commit skips CI because these exact manifests have already been built and validated.
          BODY
          pr_url=$(gh pr create --base "$DEFAULT_BRANCH" --head "$update_branch" \
            --title 'chore: update sandbox image versions [skip ci]' --body-file "$body_file")
          GH_TOKEN="[REDACTED]" gh pr merge "$pr_url" --admin --squash \
            --match-head-commit "$update_commit" \
            --subject 'chore: update sandbox image versions [skip ci]'
          git push origin --delete "$update_branch"

name: Discover Sandbox Versions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1,13 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: sandbox-version-discovery
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Test Discovery and Catalog Logic
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
      - name: Discover and Generate Missing Tracks
        run: |
          python3 scripts/discover_versions.py --write --output /tmp/new-templates.json
          python3 scripts/build.py --validate
          python3 scripts/readme.py
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Build and Smoke Test New Tracks
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          import subprocess
          for identifier in json.load(open('/tmp/new-templates.json')):
              subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/build.py', '--template', identifier,
                              '--prune-build-cache'], check=True)
          PY
      - uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          branch: automation/new-sandbox-versions
          delete-branch: true
          commit-message: 'chore: add new sandbox runtime tracks'
          title: 'Add newly released sandbox runtime tracks'
          body: |
            Adds newer stable upstream language and operating-system tracks discovered from official image tags.

            Each new template passed a linux/arm64 build and its runtime/tool smoke tests in the discovery workflow. Manifests start at version 0; the image publishing workflow publishes them after merge.

            Specialized dependency pins and combined development environments are maintained separately.
          add-paths: |
            */build/**
            */manifest.json
            README.md

import io
import json
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'scripts'))
import pack

BASE_URL = 'https://sandbox-images.pages.dev'


class PackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.template = self.root / 'example-1'
        self.context = self.template / 'build'
        self.context.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.context / 'Dockerfile').write_text('FROM ubuntu:24.04\n')
        (self.context / 'nested').mkdir()
        (self.context / 'nested/hello.sh').write_text('echo hello\n')
        self.manifest = dict(schemaVersion=1, id='example-1', name='Example', description='Example image',
                             platform='linux/arm64', runtime='example', runtimeVersion='1', version=1,
                             digest='sha256:' + 'a' * 64,
                             image='ghcr.io/example/image@sha256:' + 'a' * 64, smokeTest=['bash', '--version'])
        (self.template / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.manifest))
        self.output = self.root / 'dist'

    def test_archive_is_deterministic_and_extracts_at_context_root(self):
        first = pack.archive_context(self.context)
        (self.context / 'Dockerfile').touch()
        self.assertEqual(first, pack.archive_context(self.context))
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(first), mode='r:gz') as archive:
            self.assertEqual(archive.getnames(), ['Dockerfile', 'nested/hello.sh'])
            self.assertTrue(all(entry.uid == 0 and entry.mtime == 0 for entry in archive))

    def test_catalog_descriptors_match_served_assets_and_input_changes_change_urls(self):
        entries = pack.pack(self.output, BASE_URL, root=self.root)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.output / 'index.json').read_text())['templates'], entries)
        for field in ['manifest', 'build']:
            descriptor = entries[0][field]
            data = (self.output / descriptor['url'].removeprefix(BASE_URL + '/')).read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(descriptor['bytes'], len(data))
            self.assertEqual(descriptor['sha256'], pack.checksum(data))
        (self.context / 'Dockerfile').write_text('FROM ubuntu:26.04\n')
        next_entries = pack.pack(self.root / 'next', BASE_URL, root=self.root)
        self.assertNotEqual(entries[0]['build']['url'], next_entries[0]['build']['url'])

    def test_production_rejects_unpublished_templates(self):
        self.manifest.update(version=0, image=None, digest=None)
        (self.template / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.manifest))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            pack.pack(self.output, BASE_URL, root=self.root)
        entries = pack.pack(self.output, BASE_URL, root=self.root, allow_unpublished=True)
        self.assertFalse(entries[0]['published'])

    def test_retains_old_release_files_and_rejects_corruption(self):
        old = self.root / 'old'
        entries = pack.pack(old, BASE_URL, root=self.root)
        def fetch(request, timeout):
            url = request.full_url
            return io.BytesIO((old / url.removeprefix(BASE_URL + '/')).read_bytes())
        (self.context / 'Dockerfile').write_text('FROM ubuntu:26.04\n')
        with patch.object(pack, 'urlopen', side_effect=fetch):
            pack.pack(self.output, BASE_URL, root=self.root, retain=True)
        inventory = json.loads((self.output / 'releases.json').read_text())['releases']
        self.assertEqual(len(inventory), 2)
        self.assertTrue((self.output / entries[0]['build']['url'].removeprefix(BASE_URL + '/')).exists())
        (old / entries[0]['build']['url'].removeprefix(BASE_URL + '/')).write_bytes(b'corrupt')
        with patch.object(pack, 'urlopen', side_effect=fetch), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            pack.pack(self.root / 'bad', BASE_URL, root=self.root, retain=True)

    def test_context_rejects_symlinks(self):
        (self.context / 'unsafe').symlink_to('/etc/passwd')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            pack.archive_context(self.context)

    def test_rejects_unsafe_origin_and_oversized_asset(self):
        for url in ['http://example.com', 'https://example.com?token=x', 'https://example.com/catalog']:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                pack.pack(self.output, url, root=self.root)
        with patch.object(pack, 'MAX_ASSET_BYTES', 1), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            pack.pack(self.output, BASE_URL, root=self.root)

import importlib.util
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('discovery', Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'scripts/discover_versions.py')
discovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(discovery)
SOURCES = json.loads((discovery.ROOT / 'scripts/version-sources.json').read_text())


class DiscoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_stable_new_arm64_tracks_only(self):
        source = next(s for s in SOURCES if s['family'] == 'bun')
        tags = [{'name': n, 'images': [{'os': 'linux', 'architecture': arch}]} for n, arch in [
            ('1.4-debian', 'arm64'), ('1.3-debian', 'arm64'), ('1.4.1-debian', 'arm64'),
            ('1.5-canary-debian', 'arm64'), ('2.0-debian', 'amd64')]]
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            self.assertEqual(discovery.candidates(source, tags, root), [('1.4', '1.4-debian')])
            (root / 'bun-1.4').mkdir()
            self.assertEqual(discovery.candidates(source, tags, root), [])

    def test_ubuntu_lts_only(self):
        source = next(s for s in SOURCES if s['family'] == 'ubuntu')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            result = discovery.candidates(source, [{'name': n} for n in ['25.04','26.04','26.10','28.04']], Path(directory))
            self.assertEqual(result, [('26.04','26.04'), ('28.04','28.04')])

    def test_java_lts_only(self):
        source = next(s for s in SOURCES if s['family'] == 'java')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            result = discovery.candidates(source, [{'name': n} for n in ['3-eclipse-temurin-26', '3-eclipse-temurin-27', '3-eclipse-temurin-29']], Path(directory))
            self.assertEqual(result, [('29', '3-eclipse-temurin-29')])

    def test_deno_uses_latest_stable_patch_for_new_major(self):
        source = next(s for s in SOURCES if s['family'] == 'deno')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            result = discovery.candidates(source, [{'name': n} for n in ['debian-2.10.0','debian-3.0.2','debian-3.0.10']], Path(directory))
            self.assertEqual(result, [('3', 'debian-3.0.10')])

    def test_generated_template_resets_publication_and_keeps_stages(self):
        source = next(s for s in SOURCES if s['family'] == 'java')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            seed = root / source['seed']
            (seed / 'build').mkdir(parents=True)
            original = json.loads((discovery.ROOT / source['seed'] / 'manifest.json').read_text())
            original.update(version=8, image='published', digest='digest')
            (seed / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(original))
            (seed / 'build/Dockerfile').write_text('FROM gradle:9.1.0-jdk25 AS gradle\nFROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-25\n')
            identifier = discovery.create_template(source, '26', '3.9-eclipse-temurin-26', root)
            manifest = json.loads((root / identifier / 'manifest.json').read_text())
            self.assertEqual((manifest['version'],manifest['image'],manifest['digest']), (0,None,None))
            self.assertEqual(manifest['runtimeVersion'], '26')
            self.assertEqual((root / identifier / 'build/Dockerfile').read_text(),
                'FROM gradle:9.1.0-jdk25 AS gradle\nFROM maven:3-eclipse-temurin-26\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('build', Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'scripts/build.py')
build = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(build)

DIGEST_A = 'sha256:' + 'a' * 64
DIGEST_B = 'sha256:' + 'b' * 64
REPOSITORY = 'ghcr.io/metorial/sandbox-images/ubuntu-24.04'


class VersionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.manifest = copy.deepcopy(dict(build.discover())[build.ROOT / 'ubuntu-24.04/manifest.json'])
        self.manifest.update(version=0, image=None, digest=None)

    def test_initial_publish_and_unchanged_rebuild(self):
        first = build.next_manifest(self.manifest, DIGEST_A, REPOSITORY)
        self.assertEqual(first['version'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(first['image'], REPOSITORY + '@' + DIGEST_A)
        self.assertIsNone(build.next_manifest(first, DIGEST_A, REPOSITORY))
        self.assertEqual(self.manifest['version'], 0)

    def test_changed_output_increments_only_once(self):
        first = build.next_manifest(self.manifest, DIGEST_A, REPOSITORY)
        second = build.next_manifest(first, DIGEST_B, REPOSITORY)
        self.assertEqual(second['version'], 2)
        self.assertIsNone(build.next_manifest(second, DIGEST_B, REPOSITORY))

    def test_rejects_invalid_digest_and_registry_migration(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build.next_manifest(self.manifest, 'bad', REPOSITORY)
        first = build.next_manifest(self.manifest, DIGEST_A, REPOSITORY)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build.next_manifest(first, DIGEST_A, 'ghcr.io/other/image')

    def test_catalog_rejects_inconsistent_published_manifest(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            template = root / self.manifest['id']
            (template / 'build').mkdir(parents=True)
            (template / 'build/Dockerfile').write_text('FROM ubuntu:24.04\n')
            self.manifest['version'] = 1
            (template / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.manifest))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build.discover(root)

    def test_build_failure_does_not_publish_or_write_manifests(self):
        before = (build.ROOT / 'ubuntu-24.04/manifest.json').read_bytes()
        with patch('sys.argv', ['build.py', '--publish']), patch.object(build, 'publish') as publish:
            with patch.object(build, 'build', side_effect=[(Path('unused.tar'), DIGEST_A), RuntimeError('failed build')]):
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                    build.main()
            publish.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual((build.ROOT / 'ubuntu-24.04/manifest.json').read_bytes(), before)


    def test_registry_failure_does_not_update_any_manifests(self):
        snapshots = {path: path.read_bytes() for path, _ in build.discover()}
        with patch('sys.argv', ['build.py', '--publish']):
            with patch.object(build, 'build', return_value=(Path('unused.tar'), DIGEST_A)):
                with patch.object(build, 'publish', side_effect=[None, RuntimeError('registry unavailable')]):
                    with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                        build.main()
        for path, before in snapshots.items():
            self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_catalog_requires_dependency_locks(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            template = root / self.manifest['id']
            (template / 'build').mkdir(parents=True)
            (template / 'build/Dockerfile').write_text('FROM ubuntu:24.04\n')
            (template / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.manifest))
            for source, lock in [('requirements.in', 'requirements.txt'), ('package.json', 'package-lock.json')]:
                (template / 'build' / source).write_text('')
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build.discover(root)
                (template / 'build' / lock).write_text('')
                self.assertEqual(len(build.discover(root)), 1)

    def test_matrix_lists_every_template(self):
        with patch('sys.argv', ['build.py', '--matrix']), patch('builtins.print') as output:
            build.main()
        matrix = json.loads(output.call_args.args[0])
        self.assertEqual(matrix['template'], [manifest['id'] for _, manifest in build.discover()])

    def test_single_template_publish_updates_only_selected_manifest(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / 'manifest.json'
            path.write_text(json.dumps(self.manifest))
            other = dict(self.manifest, id='other')
            with patch('sys.argv', ['build.py', '--publish', '--template', self.manifest['id']]):
                with patch.object(build, 'discover', return_value=[(path, self.manifest), (Path('other'), other)]):
                    with patch.object(build, 'build', return_value=(Path('unused.tar'), DIGEST_A)) as builder:
                        with patch.object(build, 'publish') as publisher:
                            build.main()
            builder.assert_called_once()
            publisher.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text()), build.next_manifest(self.manifest, DIGEST_A, REPOSITORY))

    def test_merge_requires_complete_valid_results_before_writing(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory) / 'source'
            results = Path(directory) / 'results'
            results.mkdir()
            for identifier in [self.manifest['id'], 'other']:
                template = root / identifier
                (template / 'build').mkdir(parents=True)
                (template / 'build/Dockerfile').write_text('FROM ubuntu:24.04\n')
                (template / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(self.manifest, id=identifier)))
                (results / identifier).mkdir()
            before = {path: path.read_bytes() for path, _ in build.discover(root)}
            updated = build.next_manifest(self.manifest, DIGEST_A, REPOSITORY)
            (results / self.manifest['id'] / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(updated))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build.merge_manifests(results, 'ghcr.io/metorial/sandbox-images', root)
            other = dict(self.manifest, id='other')
            result_path = results / 'other' / 'manifest.json'
            result_path.write_text(json.dumps(dict(other, name='unexpected modification')))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build.merge_manifests(results, 'ghcr.io/metorial/sandbox-images', root)
            for path, content in before.items():
                self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), content)
            result_path.write_text(json.dumps(other))
            self.assertEqual(build.merge_manifests(results, 'ghcr.io/metorial/sandbox-images', root), 1)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((root / self.manifest['id'] / 'manifest.json').read_text()), updated)
            self.assertEqual(build.merge_manifests(results, 'ghcr.io/metorial/sandbox-images', root), 0)
            (results / 'unexpected').mkdir()
            (results / 'unexpected/manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(other))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build.merge_manifests(results, 'ghcr.io/metorial/sandbox-images', root)
